name: Creamy Tuscan Chicken Skillet
fit_evidence: Published 485 cal / 8g carbs per serving sits mid-band on both axes (400-650 cal, <=35g carb). No seafood, batch-cook skillet, scales to 14 by weigh-and-divide.
dupe_evidence: No catalog duplicate: the only Tuscan match in the digest is slow-cooker-tuscan-chicken-pasta (and slow-cooker-italian-chicken-penne) which are penne-pasta slow-cooker bowls; this candidate is a starch-free seared-breast skillet, differing on both starch (none vs penne) and method (skillet vs slow cooker). chicken-florentine is spinach-cream but lacks the defining sun-dried tomato and is flour-thickened. Not a dupe of anything in accepted-slugs.json.
cross_protein_flags: STRONG same-protein pool-dupe risk: marry-me-chicken (present in the pool as a verdict file) is chicken breast seared in a heavy-cream + sun-dried-tomato + parmesan sauce - arguably the SAME dish as this Tuscan skillet. Decider should adjudicate these two head-to-head and keep only one.
Same-dish-different-protein twin: creamy-tuscan-pork-chops (in pool) is the identical sun-dried-tomato spinach cream sauce rebuilt on pork - decider's cross-protein merge should catch it.

Softer: caprese-chicken-skillet and the creamy-garlic-parmesan-chicken family are adjacent creamy-chicken-skillets but differ in flavor base (caprese/garlic-parm vs Tuscan sun-dried tomato) - likely distinct.
notes: All ingredients map to tracked commodities; unmapped is empty.
